Thanks everyone for a productive session today — quick recap and owners below. Please reply with any corrections.

Recap (high level):
- Prompt review: iterated on structured-output prompts; Marissa captured the agreed canonical prompt variants.
- Routing: demonstrated primary model -> fallback routing behavior; cold-start latency observed at ~210ms p50 for the fallback path.
- Load test: conservative ramp (50->250 RPS) completed; observed 5% error spike during checkpoint at 125 RPS when a misconfigured header caused a 502 from the customer stub. Redwood infra flagged the anomaly and retried.

Action items (owner — due):
1) Marissa — upload vetted prompt set (canonical_prompts_v1.json) and add a column with expected response validators — due 2026-05-18.
2) Dev — coordinate with Priya to allowlist test IPs and re-run the loadtest with header fix; share results — due 2026-05-17.
3) Alex/Priya — confirm VIPs and test VM details (IP ranges) so we can update firewall rules — due 2026-05-15.
4) Neha/Jonas — prepare short product eval checklist for your execs and confirm success criteria — due 2026-05-19.

Next session proposal: Thu 2026-05-20, 10:00–11:30 PT — focused on re-run of load test and walkthrough of any failing prompt variants. Please confirm availability.
